description: jQuery plugin source code implementing offset and position methods for DOM elements, including calculations for element offsets, positions, and related CSS hooks.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset of a DOM element relative to the document, adjusting position based on provided options.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the offset of the first element in the set relative to the document.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Calculates the position of the element relative to its offset parent.

methods.name: offsetParent
methods.description: Returns the closest offset parent of the element.
